title: NEOlution: An Ontological Framework and Mechanics of Transcending the Brain's Reductive Filter
description: An integral scientific-philosophical synthesis unifying empirical findings in neurobiology, quantum contextuality, information theory, and metamathematics with classical consciousness mechanics (Samkhya, Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, Advaita). The preprint demonstrates that the human brain functions not as a generator of consciousness, but as a reductive filter operating on the biochemical principle of progressive addiction, and outlines a deterministic biomechanical protocol for releasing this filter. Alongside the core ontology, the repository specifies the Invisible College 2.0 Consortium (GENESIS.md) and its active contextual ledger (KARMA.md): a post-Cartesian, fractal organizational architecture of autonomous 12+1 cells governed by consent, subsidiarity, an open-protocol shared AI coordination layer, and cryptographically witnessed plain-text reputation without central hierarchies or speculative tokens.
